function W2({width:n,height:i,hudLayout:o={},safe:u=o.viewport?.safeAreaInsets||{}}){const c={...pb.base.regions.match3Composition,...o.regions?.match3Composition},f=ue=>Math.max(0,Number(ue)||0),d=Object.fromEntries(["top","right","bottom","left"].map(ue=>[ue,f(u[ue])])),h=n>i,b=n>=c.largeGutterWidth?c.largeGutter:c.gutter,g=Math.max(1,n-d.left-d.right-2*b),y=Math.max(1,i-d.top-d.bottom-2*b),x=d.left+b,R=d.top+b,L=(ue,Me,E,U)=>({left:ue,top:Me,width:E,height:U});let D,I,j,X,te,me,ae,re;if(h){re=y<=c.landscapeCompactHeight,ae=re?c.landscapeCompactGap:c.landscapeGap;const ue=Math.min(g*c.railMaxFraction,Math.max(c.railMin,Math.min(c.railMax,g*c.railFraction))),Me=re?c.railCompactGap:c.railGap,E=Math.max(1,Math.min(y,g-ue-Me,c.landscapeMaxBoard)),U=E+Me+ue,J=x+(g-U)/2;j=L(J,R+(y-E)/2,E,E);let ie=re?c.landscapeCompactRows.find(B=>y>=B.minHeight)?.rows:c.landscapeRows;ie||(ae=c.landscapeTightGap,ie=[0,Math.max(c.tightHudMin,y-c.tightRowsFixedHeight),c.tightSelection,c.tightTools,0]);const ne=ie.filter(B=>B>0),S=ne.reduce((B,V)=>B+V,0)+ae*(ne.length-1);let C=R+Math.max(0,(y-S)/2);const O=B=>{if(!B)return null;const V=L(J+E+Me,C,ue,B);return C+=B+ae,V};D=O(ie[0]),I=O(ie[1]),X=O(ie[2]),te=O(ie[3]),me=O(ie[4])}else{re=g<=c.portraitCompactWidth||y<c.portraitCompactHeight,ae=re?c.portraitCompactGap:c.portraitGap;const ue=re?c.portraitCompactRows:c.portraitRows,Me=ue.filter(C=>C>0),E=Me.reduce((C,O)=>C+O,0)+ae*Me.length,U=Math.max(1,Math.min(g,y-E,c.portraitMaxBoard)),J=E+U,ie=Math.min(g,Math.max(U,Math.min(g,c.minChromeWidth)));let ne=R+Math.max(0,(y-J)/2);const S=(C,O=ie)=>{if(!C)return null;const B=L(x+(g-O)/2,ne,O,C);return ne+=C+ae,B};D=S(ue[0]),I=S(ue[1]),j=S(U,U),X=S(ue[2]),te=S(ue[3]),me=S(ue[4])}const se=Math.min(c.frameInset,j.width/8),q=L(j.left+se,j.top+se,j.width-se*2,j.height-se*2);q.rows=8,q.cols=8,q.cell=q.width/8,q.size=q.width,q.frame=j;const xe=re?c.toolCompactGap:c.toolGap,Te=h?3:5,pt=h?2:1,je=(te.width-xe*(Te-1))/Te,ce=(te.height-xe*(pt-1))/pt,it=Array.from({length:5},(ue,Me)=>L(te.left+Me%Te*(je+xe),te.top+Math.floor(Me/Te)*(ce+xe),je,ce));return{width:n,height:i,safe:d,landscape:h,compact:re,gutter:b,gap:ae,title:D,hud:I,frame:j,board:q,selection:X,tools:te,mode:me,buttons:it,frameInset:se}}
